title: A request without details is asked for them, and the answer starts the pipeline again
covers: the issue gate asks for details instead of planning a request it cannot act on
a reply with the details on a needs-info issue gets a new analysis and the pipeline continues

issue.title: Make the tree thing better
issue.body: It would be nice if the tree thing was better. Please look into it.

steps.comment: Sorry, I was not clear. `flattenTree` should take an optional `maxDepth` argument. With `maxDepth: 1` it should list the root and its direct children only, and nothing below them. Without it the function must behave as it does today. Where the argument goes is up to you. A test should cover both cases.

checks.name: the plan worker left one plan
needs-info was cleared once the details arrived
